lines.say: My best client stopped getting his hair cut. So I kicked his fucking door down.
caps: My best client stopped getting his hair cut.
So I kicked his *fucking* door down.

lines.say: His mom came out swinging. So I fought his mom. In the front yard. In my apron.
Then I drove to his grandma's house. Because I'm thorough. She is eighty one years old. She hit me with a skillet. Twice.
caps: Then I drove to his grandma's house.
She hit me with a skillet.

lines.say: Comment KEEP if you've ever chased a client this hard.
lines.show: Comment KEEP if you've ever chased a client this hard.

lines.say: Turns out, Dray wasn't even home. He heard what I did, and fainted. Now he's in the hospital.
lines.show: Turns out, Dre wasn't even home. He heard what I did, and fainted. Now he's in the hospital.

lines.say: So I brought him soup. Chicken noodle. I left the big bones in, for flavor.
caps: I left the big bones in.

lines.say: He choked. Flatlined. Nurses screaming. Then he coughed up one bone, grabbed my hand, and whispered his last words.
That's it. That's the whole reason. He never left me. Nobody told him to come back.
caps: Nobody told him to come back.

lines.say: So now I use Message Health. It spots who's gone quiet, and texts them for me, before they forget.
lines.show: So now I use MsgHealth. It spots who's gone quiet, and texts them for me, before they forget.

lines.say: No door. No grandma. No soup. Just a text.
Comment KEEP and we'll show you who's gone quiet.
